_comment: Castalia-Penta WOUND + AFE2, PER-TILE analog (topology B, 2026-09-06): config/penta_wound_afe.json VERBATIM plus afeTopology="per_tile" and a distinct chipName. The AFE2 peripheral is UNCHANGED -- four sites at 0x6C00/0x6D00/0x6E00/0x6F00, the same register map, the same 50 anatop_pixel control bits and SARADC clk/rst/rdy/d per site, the same IRQ vector 124 (source list 125). What moves is WHERE those pins leave the digital hierarchy: instead of four port groups on the MCU entity feeding one anatop_quad macro in the north-centre corridor (topology A), they are internal nets to the four channel tiles, which become hdl/common/hart_tile_pt.vhd and each carry one anatop_ch macro in the corner notch they already have. The MCU entity then has NO per-site analog ports -- only biasg_code<13:0>/biasg_en for the ONE shared anatop_biasgen_g, written through AFE0BIASG (word 9 of AFE2 site 0's sub-slot, 0x6C24: a separate one-word BIASG slave on site 0's own enable, so it costs no address slot and AFE2.vhd is untouched). chipName is PentaWoundPt so this configuration gets its OWN verify stage (xcelium/riscv_test/verify_pentawoundpt) instead of sharing verify_pentawound with the topology-A config. The package model is castalia-lqfp100-pt, the topology-B pad ring: five PRCUTA_G-isolated analog islands (one per channel corner plus the north-centre supply pair for the shared bias generator), 26 analog pads, and resolution R1 -- the LQFP-100 is kept and eleven south digital signals (GPIO3 bits 3-7, VDDPST, VSSPST and the four TAP pins) move to the north row, which topology B empties of topology A's 14-pad analog band, so the two south analog islands get package fingers. The die-row geometry is config/padring_pt.json and innovus/common/MCU_castalia_penta_pt/tcl/chip_top_wound_padlists_penta_pt.tcl; generate.py owns only the ball numbers and cross-checks the two. Build with: tools/bin/bazel build //platform/common:chip_artifacts_penta_wound_afe_pt ; gate it with //platform/common:penta_wound_afe_pt_generation_test, :penta_wound_afe_pt_memorymap_h_test, :penta_wound_afe_pt_intro_names_test and //opensource_sim/penta_wound_afe_pt:penta_wound_afe_pt_elaborate
